text:
Came here for the Eagles game on 12/1. It was unusually empty. It appears as if this place doubles as a limited bottle shop, which was cool. 

I was a bit disappointed in the draft list, but I was able to spot a few decent choices on there. The bartender was pulling all the duties it seemed and she was doing a great and friendly job and doubling as the only server in the place. I can't help but think she (and we as customers) would have been screwed if there were only 10 more people in the place. 

We ordered the old bay wings and the turkey Rachel. The wings are towards the top of the list of some of the best I ever had and a decent size as well. To top if it off it was 75 cent wings during the game. The bar is huge and environment laid back. I will definitely add it to my rotation!
I ordered the vegetarian sub and it was so freakin' yummy! Went through door dash and everything was packaged perfectly with the bag stapled. I highly recommend eating here!

Wish I could give it 6 stars. This is a great place to take your significant other out on a date. The pork tenderloin dish with the elote salad and beans was very flavorful and cooked to perfection. Overall, dining at this restaurant was a special experience. It is expensive, but well worth it. You are paying for high quality service and extraordinary meals. Also, it's a clean restaurant in a quiet neighborhood surrounded by beautiful homes.

Amazing spot! I come here all the time - they have the best breakfast sandwiches. I usually get a bacon, egg, and cheese with avocado. I've also had a bunch of their lunch items as I work in the area - their sandwiches and wraps are next level. Highly recommend. Pro tip - call ahead for sure and just pick it up.
Had the Italian subs and have to say the best I have ever eaten.  Staff was excellent.

Do you want fast healthy delicious food?  Crazy Bowls & Wraps is the best for that! Great Thai sauce to go with a high protein bowel. They make veggies and everything healthy taste yummy with the fresh veggies and sauces to add!

I'm not a fish person at all, but I finished most of a fried grouper sandwich. The U-peel shrimp looked and smelled amazing, and fries were great. Shrimp roll got good reviews; the Cuban sandwich is alright. Cole slaw is vinegar based if that's important to you, and the onion rings weren't great, but they weren't deal breakers. So 4.5 stars, and the friendly service warrants rounding up. Definitely recommended

I was really excited to stay at the Columbia Club, but the experience left me wondering how they are calling themselves a 4-star hotel. It felt like we were staying at a rundown nursing home. 

The first room we were given was a double bed with a window that had only a honeycomb blind -- not blackout and no curtains. We went to the front desk to ask for a queen size and were moved to a king. This room's windows had proper window treatments, but the bathroom was so sad. It had a drop acoustic ceiling that I'm sure was hiding a multitude of sins. The floor was mysteriously damp all night long and when we tried to wipe it dry, the towel revealed how dirty the floor was. Everything in the bathroom was mismatched and there were holes in the tile from removing towel bars that were never fixed. 

The staff is lovely (they didn't seem surprised when I said it was an "interesting" stay). And the location is great for access to downtown activities and restaurants. But it's ridiculous that a place that touts itself as exclusive -- including having a "dress code" -- doesn't hold itself to higher standards.

Soooooooo Good!!!!

This place lives up to its reputation.

My partner and I went there and loved it.  We sat outside and they took appropriate Covid safety measures.  
She loved the Israeli wine she ordered.  
I enjoyed the stout they had on rotation.  

But the real star of this place was the food.  
The pitas and sauces and dessert are set.  You pick the protein you want.  I got braised ribs and my partner got lamb kabobs.  Both were flavorful and amazing.  

I would highly recommend everyone eat at this place.  Reservation recommended.
AMAZING Cheesesteaks and broccoli poppers!! Definitely 10/10 and a must try for anybody in the area!

Oyaki Cheesesteak Dumplings were really good 
The filet -o- Cod steam bun was awesome by far my favorite also manoo  5 chicken dumplings were very good to my wife liked the Hot Chicken Steamed bun it is spicy and rice bowl with beef very good to

First and foremost the service was perfect. We had a very kind waitress. The seating arrangements is my only complaint for the restaurant, most of the seating is outside so even at 7:00 pm it was still very hot. It helped that my waitress kept my water filled. The inside seating wasn't much better because everything was open, but they did have fans. I shared this meal and between the two of us we still didn't finish it. Added bonus, you get a free O-ring appetizer just by checking in to the restaurant! They were delicious. I would definitely return, if there is a good breeze that is.

Wow this is good Indian. I've been to Hyderabad and Mumbai 5 times In last 2 years. Also have eaten in curry shops in London and this place keeps up with all of them. It's not perfect...but we are in newtown PA so it's pretty damn close. Service is good to boot and they have a full bar with good wine and beer selection. 

Pretty standard "american India restaurant" menu with few unique items. Actually wish they were a little more innovative with a few less known things. 

All in all highly recommended if you like fresh and authentic Indian cuisine in a nice setting with good friendly service and a good wine/beer list to boot.

Drove 25 minutes to come see a movie here and they won't allow you to purchase tickets in a half empty theatre with plenty of room to socially distance. Online system doesn't have the movie as sold out and the managers only response is sorry. What a joke. Good to know you're running movies at half capacity because your staff and your infrastructure is incompetent.

I have only good things to say about Osteria! My boyfriend and I came by during happy hour to treat ourselves after a long week. It was definitely a meal I will always remember. 

We went a little over the top and ordered 5 things off the menu just for the two of us. We started off with the vegatable antipasti, which was a delicious variety of roasted vegetables, arugula and other greens, and a few slices of parmesan. So good and beautifully seasoned! The mamma pina's polpette was also delicious. They gave two big veal meatballs. Next, we tried the lombarda pizza. That definitely was the star of the show. The egg on top surprised me (in a good way). Later, we got two pastas, the francoboli ravioli and chicken liver rigatoni. The ravioli melted in my mouth and had amazing mushroom flavor. The rigatoni had the subtle bitter taste of liver, so it was not my fave. However, if you like liver, definitely try it! 

All of this was a total of $35 during happy hour. I ain't mad about that! I hope to come back soon when I'm in Philadelphia again :)
The pad Thai and sushi we ordered as takeout were great!  Very fresh and flavorful. Also tried the curry puffs as an app and they were really good; crunchy outside and very filling!

Very good breakfast! We ordered the mimosa kit (that came with beignets), Chile verdee omelette and the Denver omelette. Everything was very delicious, but the chile verses omelette is TO DIE FOR! The sauce is super tasty and needs nothing in addition. The beignets are fluffy and sweet!! I will definitely come back when in town. I'd even make the LA to SB trip again to eat here for breakfast. No lie. Very good and the staff is really friendly! They're doing a great job keeping people a part
A long time fave did not disappoint with Quarantine Easter Dinner Take Out!  Amazing dinner. Thank you and be safe!

I've been Maurizio's many of times after games with my friends and have never had a bad experience. Last night had to have been the worst night ever. Me and my boyfriend wanted to enjoy a nice pizza after the blues game, but who would've thought that we would get horrible service. When we got there around 1:00am it was a little crowded which is understandable because it was a game night. We sat at the bar and tried to order food but were told by a bartender Jason that we had to go to the other side if we wanted food because he would only serving drinks. Again not a problem, but the bartender Jason became awfully rude telling us I quote "I don't care about your 3$ tips!" and "You can f#%* leave, I've been here since 10am and don't give a f%*^!" I understand things can get overwhelming, and I assume that the entire day was crazy packed, but that's not how you treat customers. All we wanted was to chow down on some good food after a bad game!

I will start by saying they are a bit more expensive than average (about $15-20 per), but it was well worth it. 

My wife wanted take out from here since the pandemic continues. I was skeptical. She made the right call as she usually does. I picked it up myself and the food was fresh, hot and on-time. 

I had fettuccine Alfredo and she got chicken parmigiana both were excellent. Six garlic knots came with our meals as well as house salads. 

I look forward to the post pandemic times when I can eat inside, take my time and enjoy a meal there.

This place is easily one of the best falafel spots in the city! My wife got the Samantha's combo platter and I, the falafel combo platter. Her platter came with 4 falafels, 1 eggplant, and 1 latke. Both were also served with hummus, slaw, salad, and a a pita. My platter came with 8 (!) falafel balls. 

The falafel was crispy and very flavorful. The salad was great. The hummus was what you'd expect. They also have a salad bar on the side where you can help yourself to sauces, pickles, and even hot peppers! 

The guys are great that work here, Justin was really helpful and was very friendly! 

Mama's truly is a place we will come back to pretty often! They offer a catering option as well, with great prices! 

The only downfall is that they are cash only but don't let that stop you from checking this place out. Run to wawa down the street beforehand if you need cash.. or use their atm inside.

I've always enjoyed Buffalo Wild Wings food but the service at this location is just so terrible. I frequent this place all the time and between the combination of being ignored when needing help, having to refill my own drinks because no one else, food coming out cold or often, or recently waiting 40 minutes past my schedule pick-up time when it comes to restaurant pick up service. Don't get me wrong, I've had good experiences here as well. But be bad or mediocre have been out weighing the good . Would be much faster and cheaper you just fry up your own Wings and buy B-Dubs sauce
Nice outdoor dining. Old school waiter. Music from near by street musicians. So good America food . Love the variety.

Great sandwich shop! Super friendly service and the sandwiches were great. I highly recommend the chicken parm sandwich. The pickles are also delicious. Sandwiches came out quickly and were really fresh.

The atmosphere and food is wonderful. I always enjoy my meal at The Gables and tonight was no exception. We sat at a table in the cozy bar area. The pianist was delightful and really enhanced the evening. I had the shrimp and grits ....very tasty. My husband had the  steak frites...delicious. Staff was friendly from the minute we arrived. Can't wait to go back!

Long time Yelp viewer, first time reviewer.
My party arrived at 9:30am Sunday December 13. I was enthusiastically greeted was told there was a few minute wait. I put my name in and in less than 5 minutes we were seated with coffee to boot.
Good looking menu, I chose the Veggie Chimichanga, since I've seen other reviews on this choice. Get it! You'll not be disappointed. You're welcome! Packed with veggies and flavor. Don't worry that it's deep fried as it came out flakey, not heavy. 
Coffee cup was kept full, server was attentive.
This is a family owned restaurant and they do a great job. Food was hot and tasty, the bussers were actively wiping tables, chairs, etc. Please take a visit, you'll not be disappointed.
In addition I got ducked, my first one! 
#jeeplife #duckingjeeps #duckduckjeep
#Breakfast Chimichanga

This is probably my favorite barbecue spot in town. If you are looking for good old Classic style barbecue but with all the flavor from the South this is the place for you. A cool casual atmosphere that has a lot of soul and history all throughout. Come down and say hi to the owners and operators of this fantastic locally black owned restaurant. Cheers!

Toast has my heart!!! This is one of the best brunch places around! Their opinions are unique and taste wonderful! Their dine in is set up socially distanced and the staff was wearing masks! They were super helpful when we were ordering! Those abelskivers and so good! Why have normal pancakes when you can have puffed pancakes! We got the lemon curd as a dipping sauce! It was tangy and delicious! We also got the avocado toast which came with a fried egg on top! The toast it was on was very very good! It was thick but soft to bite into! Then for my entree I got the omelet with bacon, gruyere,  and spinach! The meal was among one of the best brunch dive ever had! So your probably wondering- why 4 stars then? Well...they had flies. The flies gets getting in my face and landing on my hands/arms. They also kept flying around our food. It was getting kind of annoying to keep swatting them away!
The oysters are worth the indigestion that always follows. It is a little crazy and loud in the restaurant but you can tune it all out when the oysters arrive.

Went in on a Sunday morning around 730am.  Good selection of doughnuts and they were excellent.  Wanted to sit down and eat them but there were boxes on every single chair and table in the place for people who had pre-ordered.  Being from out of town, we had to sit in our car and eat them.  Maybe they should set up a baker's rack for pre-orders so patrons can enjoy their doughnut and coffee in the store?

Kahwa Coffee you are totally exceptional, I had a lovely experience here today. Can not talk highly enough about Kahwa Coffee. I could hardly decided what to order, but I am so happy that I got Goat Cheese Quiche, it was absolutely magnificent. The team are super attentive and nice and they're great at giving recommendations. You will really like Kahwa Coffee.

My friend and I were looking for inexpensive Mexican food more outside the city and boy did we find it! Their food is delicious and large enough portions for even a big eater like me to have leftovers. We called in an order and it only took 15 minutes for our food to be ready. When we got there, we didn't have to get out of the car and were able to use a mobile card reader (which the waitress said was a much needed upgrade for them). The lady that brought our food to us and processed our payment was friendly, polite, and exercised appropriate precautions for safety in the COVID era. I will definitely be frequenting this restaurant.
Drop by at this Mediterranean restaurant on Friday, Saturday and Sunday and experience the best buffet in town. Need i say more!
Brent and Maddie are the freaking best , come here and have a good time! Order the pickles

After receiving recommendations from a few people I ordered and thought the meal was excellent. I will become a regular and try the rest of their menu, great food and service and I'll be back for more.
Great food and service! The waiter was very attentive and recommended different foods based on what I liked. Everything came out delicious.

We were visiting Tucson and found this absolute gem. Our waitress was super sweet and attentive and I cannot day enough about how amazing the food was. We started with the bruschetta appetizer. Omg. They were all different and each was better than the last. I strongly recommend ordering this...a very creative idea as an appetizer and I love it. We weren't super hungry so we split the mushroom ravioli entree with the walnut cream sauce. It was sooo good. After trying it I immediately regretted the decision to split. It was so good no matter how full I was I'm certain I could have finished it myself. We were only here for three days and of all the restaurants we ate at in Tucson, this one was my favorite!!
This place is a dream. We got a few Bao sandwiches and each bite was delicious and melted in your mouth.
Since my last post...I have not had any issues with orders not being ready when I was sent a text. I am a consistently satisfied customer.

Fantastic new burger concept!  Completely unique with plenty of options.  All of the ingredients are very fresh.  The grilled chicken California style is amazing!  Made from scratch onion rings are great and the sweet potato fries are delicious.  You can even order half and half!  I will definitely be a returning customer.
The food was subpar at best. The guacamole was bland. The fajitas were greasy and the cast iron sizzle pan left a rusty taste. The server was polite but very slow. What I did enjoy was the Margarita.

If you're seriously into carbs, then they have some good stuff. Various types of bread in addition to the pizzas. The ricotta board has especially nice rosemary bread and it's pretty tasty. The chicken masala was good and the duck breast cheesesteak creamy, though I had to skip half of the bread.

Service could be a little less matter of fact. If a customer complains about a dirty cup you should at least say  "I'm sorry"

Nice ambience and view. In all a pleasant place for lunch or dinner.

We just ate here this evening for a friends birthday and had a frustrating time with the service. Our drinks took 30 min to get to the table, food wasn't any better 45min. The place was not that busy. Our server kept making excuses and bad talking the bar staff. I ordered a second drink to have with dinner and it didn't show up for another 35+min and at this point we were just ready for our check and to get out of the place. The waitress tried to guilt us by still bringing the drinks even though we told her we no longer wanted them and she didn't even offer to comp them considering the insane amount of time we waited. Mind you, at this point there's like 4 tables in the place. Terrible experience.

The only reason we came to this place is because we wanted to sit out on their patio for a nice little breakfast we had never tried before. Contrary to what we hoped for it is well below average . I wouldn't say it's the Grossest restaurant in the world but the Filthy tables outside with flies everywhere and random bowls of water on the ground were a very obvious indication of one . When I asked if our waiter could please wipe the dirty table down he used what looked like a used dirty rag that had holes in it and hadn't seen a drop of disinfectant , soap , nor water . The water here served in outdated melamine cups  tasted like it came straight out of an old elementary school drinking fountain . Basically like a mouth full of nickels with every flinching sip . Not to mention disgusting ass food that came after and service on the very slow side . I truly cannot think of a worse place at the moment . .
such a horrifying experience. girl made our burritos without gloves on! bare hands grabbing toppings and rolling burrito. no no no no no. just no.

The only bad thing is the bar is not open yet. I cannot say enough good things about this place! I highly recommend it it's very authentic. My friend cooks a lot of Cajun and even he said this is not your typical Midwest Cajun but is the real thing. 

I ordered the mussels and calamari

I emailed Samurai Blue two weeks ago to let them know about issues that I had with my food and never heard back from them. My issues were: first I was informed that the order would be ready in 25min but it wasn't ready for 45 minutes. We ordered 4 rolls. One of the rolls that I ordered was the lobster tempura roll. While it tasted good, 3 pieces didn't have any lobster tempura at all on it and 2 pieces only had the tempura batter but no lobster.  This is very disappointing.  Also the Hawaiian roll tasted great but the rainbow and crunchy spicy tuna rolls didn't taste that good. The nori paper had a weird aftertaste and the tuna in rolls was mushy and not same quality as tuna in other rolls that I got.

While visiting Tampa Bay for my daughters spring break, my best friend and our girls tried multiple restaurants but Frenchy's Rockaway Grill was by far the best. I definitely plan on trying others in the chain! We were told there would be a 15 minute wait and it was more like 40. I certainly don't mind waiting but it was clearly busy and the hostess might have given a greater estimate to decrease annoyance. Personally, it was whatever, but there were some attitudes around us. Once seated, our server Alissa was with us in such a timely manner that it was a relief after our wait! She recommended excellent adult beverages and some sort of tuna avocado dish for an appetizer that was out of this world! She was fun and made the experience better, especially since she made great recommendations. None of us were disappointed! The bathroom was a little dirty but that's to be expected with such a crowd I suppose. I definitely recommend going there!

You better know what to order. Some entrees are acceptable- not outstanding , and others bordered on inedible. I think the secret is to order an item that absolutely has to be freshly prepared e.g. almost any Kabob . Meat entrees served with a sauce, ( at least at my table of 9 diners ) were clearly reheated in that the meat was dry and stringy - something the lavish amounts of sauce could not disguise. Ordering medium rare lamb kabobs is the way to go . No way can one disguise reheating that and the plate I was given was  OK , but far from the meals I've had in the near east including , back in the day , Tehran and more recently Istanbul and even New York.  My fellow diners also praised the chicken kabobs . So your choices are limited despite a very extensive menu. Service was acceptable.
I wanted to really loves this place, but I found the Jackfruit bbq and macaroni and cheese underwhelming. Love the concept and hope improves.

I have been trying to figure out how to write a review for Spice Finch since I dined here on Friday evening. I enjoyed myself, but I don't feel like this is a place for everyone. If you're curious, keep reading I will try to layout my reasoning:

The Good: Restaurant layout is sleek/modern but remains inviting. The staff are friendly and attentive and provided good information about menu items we had questions on. 
The food is presented beautifully. The portion sizes are large for the price point (our server recommended 4 dishes [we are vegetarian] for 2 people. This amount ended up being way too much). 
The menu covers a lot of dietary choices and needs and is interesting.
I really loved the carrot hummus. The baked cheese is also basically a fancy adult deconstructed mozzarella stick and it's pretty glorious. In addition, I really enjoyed my cocktail- The Clover Club. It tasted like spring and the portion size was large.  


The Weird: The main reason I had difficulty figuring out how to rate Spice Finch is that found all of the food/drinks to have really intense, and sometimes unfamiliar flavors. Maybe it's trying to be edgy?
 All of the food is incredibly rich and hard to eat the normal portion size of. My partner's drink, Game Theory, had about a teaspoon of za'atar seasoning on top. He described it as being so heavy and spiced that it was 'almost a side dish'. 


The 'Ew No': The server recommended our main of Salted Baked Eggplant. What is going on with this dish? I ha

Ordered takeout from this location because it is very close to the hotel that we're staying at. It was ready fast and hot when we picked it up. We ordered the angel hair sautéed pasta and the kids pizza meal. The kids loved the pizza. The angel hair pasta is also yummy. It only comes with garlic bread if you are dining in, but for takeout they don't provide the garlic bread. Also the menu does not specify that it has cheese on the angel hair pasta but it comes with melted mozzarella cheese on top.

I'm considering leaving everything in my will to the owners and operators of this fine establishment. Upon a quick google search, my sister and I stumbled across this place several months ago. Both of us being avid Thai cuisine lovers, we are always interested in exploring and trying new Thai spots... that was until we found the heaven on earth that is Thai Town Cuisine. I will NEVER go anywhere else for Thai food... unless I go to Thailand itself. Who knew such an amazing Thai restaurant could even exist in the mediocre state that is Indiana. 

I have only ever gotten takeout (my sister and I prefer takeout, even pre-COVID, because we are couch potatoes and like stuffing our faces whilst binging the latest awful reality television show). That said, every meal I have ever ordered and picked up from Thai Town Cuisine has been cooked to perfection and then handed off to me with such kindness, every trip has truly been memorable. On days that I watch too much news or look through too social media and am reminded of the ugliest parts of humanity, slowly sinking into an abyss of hopelessness - I stop myself. I shut my eyes. I imagine myself picking up delicious Thai food from the kindest people who have ever walked this earth. It's in that moment that my hope is restored and I am reminded of the most life-giving things and people this world has to offer. Thai Town Cuisine has the power to cure depression and anxiety, terminal illness, mass-starvation, human division, that abnormal

the manager does not serve it is very rude and the food is not worth it and I saw cockroaches and there is an egg in the wall in front of the handicap parking lot that means there is more than cockroaches and bad food

This food is amazing! Cute, clean and delicious!
Owner is a doll!!!!! If you are in the area a must!

First time to Egg on Sunday.  Normally we wouldn't drive 25 miles downtown fo Sunday brunch, except thanks to St Louis County Health Dept Covid-19 Order.  We had no idea what to expect but we're hopeful because the Food is Love special on PBS.  We were very pleased with our Carnitas El Cedro, Lamb Sausage Shakshuka (huge/shareable), pork belly breakfast taco, and chorizo breakfast taco.  All was very good but pork belly belly taco was our favorite.  Somehow we ate it all.  Coffee was also great.  Fun eccentric place.

Loved this place. Unique cafe that sources most (if not all) of their menu items from local farms. Refreshing atmosphere compared to similar restaurants in the area. 

Service was excellent. Our waiter, Morgan, knew the ins and outs of the menu, was able to describe the specials perfectly, and answer any questions we had. 

Patio seating was just as good. You are able to see the produce that they grow for the kitchen as well as their coy pond. 

To top it all off was the food! Everything was very fresh and tasted fantastic. Large menu, so we can't wait to go back and try more of it!

This was my first time coming to Carlillos Cocina. I had read about how great their food was in a magazine and decided I'd give it a try. I'll just say that magazine knew what they were talking about because the food was excellent. I ordered chicken fajitas. The portions were generous! It was definitely enough food to leave me satisfied. The star of the plate was the red sauce that they put on top of the fajitas. And they're not shy about using the sauce either. You can watch them cook your food right in front of you where I watched as there wasn't 1, not 2, but 3 big scoops from a ladle poured over my plate. The rice also had an interesting surprise of small bits of carrots and peas in them. It was almost like a mix between Mexican rice and stir fry minus the egg. The only downside to the whole experience was they weren't serving chips and salsa. I'm not sure if that's the norm there or if it's because of covid but that wasn't too big of a deal. I'll absolutely be coming back to try the rest of the menu!

I tried a plethora of the foods. The ahi tuna was amazing, the avocado complemented it very well. The Chilean salmon was by far my favorite dish. It was very well cooked and juicy but not undercooked. I'm salivating just thinking about it. Wasn't a fan of the rib eye. It was a little dry. The Cajun pasta was good, would have been better with more sauce. The egg rolls were surprising but good! You expect Asian flavors but it was more savory than sweet with the surprising sauce. I really enjoyed it. I had several smoked old fashion drinks. The presentation is cute and you can see how they get the Smokey flavor into the drink. The dragon lady was amazing. They were out of the mahalo drink but I'd like to try it still. Looked delicious. The spicy Thai shrimp was incredible. Wasn't a fan of the chicken Milanese. It wasn't nasty but it wasn't tasty. I'd definitely suggest trying Grillsmith. Don't get me started on how friendly and knowledgeable the wait staff is. Oh the chocolate decadence is definitely a gooey moussy texture if you're into that.

Great spot for lunch, happy hour and molé sauce enthusiasts. Lunch specials are so worth the value & who could hate happy hour! Love the chicken enchiladas with molé sauce and even the vegetarian enchiladas are amazing! The chop salad is huge and super filling. Haven't had a margarita, sangria or any kind of drink here I haven't liked! This is our go to spot on Main Street !

I have no idea why there are so many five-star reviews about this restaurant. Cash-only. 30 minutes waiting. The staff became cold when he heard that we don't need drinks but only water. And the food was not that good as described. The potatoes were over toasted. Eggshells in the Kitchen Sink. A disappointing brunch.

My first time trying trilly  was on a Wednesday , guess what I came back again on Sunday , because it was that good ... The Philly cheesesteak with provolone n some pickle chips with the garlic dip was the bomb

This place is great for a date. It's pretty classy, right on the main central strip, and good food. We got three appetizers. Truffle fries, roasted octopus, and the gambas. All three were great, and they filled us (me and my girlfriend) all the way, and we like to eat. The roasted octopus was extremely good, as recommended from our hostess. The gambas was great too, extremely filling. The beer prices were cheap, depending what you got, and they had cheap wine, as well as expensive wine. The atmosphere was pretty good, but not super fancy. We ate on the street and it was loud outside for a Wednesday during covid.. Not a lot of room though, I would not recommend coming here with a party greater than 4. Overall, good food, for a premium price, I'd say you get what you pay for. Like I said, not for big parties, more of a "date" vibe.

I had no idea the different types of food and flavors this place would bring. It's more Lebanese type food! They have a couple of tables outside. We got the SoBro skillet and egg sandwich which were both flavorful and tasted good but we waited over 40 min for our food so I think it's important to note that. Their sandwich and appetizer options all looked good as well.

My mom and I drove through for lunch and shared the 10 peace chicken platter (so we can have leftovers for tmr) with the creamy garlic and ranch sauces, which are to die for, and I got a side of rice and beans. They smelled absolutely delicious so I couldn't help but have one in the car on the way home haha. I don't know how they do it but the outside is so crispy and the inside is just oh so tender. Even the rice and beans are pretty good. All in all I'm very happy, the only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because one of the tenders was a little stringy and chewy.

BEST SUSHI IN BRANDON, DARE I SAY ALL OF TAMPA, DARE I SAY ALL OF FLORIDA?! Might be extreme considering I haven't tried all of the sushi in Florida but wow, seriously this place is soooo good. I think one of the main things that makes this sushi stand out is the rice. The rice is sooo good and fresh and just makes the rolls really stand out against other places. They have tons of delicious specialty rolls but I always go for some version of spicy tuna. Always delicious!!! This place is a must!
One of the best burgers I've ever had - incredibly juicy and bursting with flavor - the Parmesan fries were also amazing! 11/10 would recommend coming here

This is the best Wendy's on planet earth  
The food is hot & delicious each and everytime. They take the time to bag your salad from your chili so the chili does not make your salad hot. The nuggets are hot & chrispy. They use real cheese on your baked potatoes. They not afraid to fill your cup with ice and then add the lemonade. Omg they give you ice cold cherry hi-c and plenty of napkins. They treat you like a valued customer. This excellent service is gonna make me forget just how poor I am this five star treatment is gonna make me think Im rich.

For a quick, fast and fresh option to get your Chinese craving this place is pretty awesome. $8.15 for a combination platter packs lots of food plus you get an egg roll. We actually drive from Sunset / 41 to go to China Moon because it's a lot more reliable then out little Chinese Express up from Winn. Egg rolls are trash, no weird taste and fold is always so hot it's hard to touch the container.

I have been eating here for 4 years and this place is amazing. One of my favorite quick bites to eat in Tucson. The staff is extremely friendly and it is family owned and operated. If you are freshman or new to the area go and try it you will not be disappointed. Ask Colby or Andrew for recommendations on pitas. Colby makes a bomb pita when he is on the grill. I don't usually write good reviews on places so go and try it for yourself and you will see what the hype is about!

Happened to spot this place by accident as it's tucked in behind a coffee store.  Big, open interior with pizza oven firewood stacked up inside.  Love the scent of fresh burning firewood coming from a traditional, wood-burning, oven.  Tried the meatball sandwich  which was delicious, bread and meatballs.  Chef sent out a couple of pizza slices for free.  Nice touch and it worked, ordered to pies to go.
Tasty beer and drinks option.
Definitely on the return visit list.
Did delivery during covid. Food was amazing! Order was correct with every side you could think of! Very spicy and loved it!!! Thank you

I went here with two friends. It's a small charming spot. The food was fresh and really good. Service was friendly. Definitely recommend making a reservation.  There is an ATM there - it's a cash only spot.  My friends ordered the gnocchi and I had the rigatoni and vegetables. It was really good - especially like the little pieces of eggplant. The tiramisu was amazing.  I will definitely go back.
Glad they are still operating hopefully they will be able to stay open later soon!   Their food is great!  Love the cheese sauce and nachos and all the tacos and last the Margaritas!
Servers were nice and attentive. Breakfast was very good. We always come here for breakfast when we are in town.

Assortment of hot foods, baklava, pita bread and international groceries. The food here is amazing and service. I have been coming here since the first opened, this is a spot that has many food options.

Awesome food and excellent music. Had the shrimp and grits - creamy, delicious, and served with the tomato sauce. Other guest and chicken and waffles - great crunch on the chicken and a little hint of vanilla in the waffles. Absolutely recommend when visiting Nashville.
Nothing fancy but very tasty! Worth the wait! Thanks Amanda for a great experience. Nice evening out with the parents! STONE CRAB

Worst experience ever ! 

The manager was sweet but my waitress Gizelda was horrible, at 9:30pm she told me the kitchen was closing in 5 mins at 9:30 when the restaurant closes at 10pm. She came to ask me if I was okay on her cellphone. I'll never come here again. They started cleaning in front of me ! She never apologize and I think her and the manager was laughing at me. Thank you for a bad experience !!!! I'll keep going to the one on veterans blvd.

Café Cuong is so underrated. It's been around for years and years. I prefer Café Cuong to Ba Le because the owners are friendly and their banh mis are incredibly cheap and delicious. I love that there is never a line. Not that it matters because we always call ahead and they are super quick. They're a cash only establishment, so be sure to have cash on hand!

Excellent food and friendly service... highly recommend.  Papa Locos is located inside a small bldg that is also a Conoco gas station, and small grocery store, and a barber shop.  It's easy to miss it when you drive by.  But make no mistake... they have excellent food, affordably priced and delivered in a professional and friendly way.  They have a few tables/booths, and a small patio with just a few tables.  I ate outside due to covid, but there were a couple of inside tables in use, socially distanced.  It seems like most customers are taking food to go.  I've been 3 times, and the food has been great every time.  Highly recommend their soft tacos (Carne Asada, Shredded Beef, and Al Pastor are best).  Also have had their Chorizo, Cheese and Egg Burrito which also was excellent.  Their Sonoran Hot Dog is phenomenal... it has a bacon wrapped hot dog with beans, grilled onions, tomato, mustard and mayo on a delicious slightly toasted bun.  The location is also very close to The Loop bicycle path.  I saw several bicyclists there for lunch.  Highly recommend.

Decided to try sweet taco and placed an order for pick up over the phone. Picked it up and walked to the car. As I was pulling out an employee stopped me thinking I got the wrong order. He checked it and said nope you're all good. Turns out we did get the wrong order. All items were incorrect.

Lesson learned, don't go to sweet taco or if you do you should always verify your own order.

I have no idea how this place ended up on my list, but after eating there today, I am thankful it did! This is their Sreuben (sub reuben) and it was phenomenal. It had house smoked pastrami, kraut, swiss, thousand island dressing, and a pumpernickel hoagie roll. Service was very fast and friendly. They had inside and outside seating which was nice. Overall, I absolutely loved my lunch and will be returning soon. Highly recommended.

We visited Legoland and wanted a quick bite to eat before heading to our hotel. The place was super clean, friendly staff and service was quick. The food was excellent. Sushi was fresh and habachi was on point.

We had heard so much about this place and were so excited to visit. But we were let down. We ordered the guacamole and it was runny and did not taste good at all. Like the ones you get from a package but worse. We only ate it because we were starving. The chips were good. We ordered wings and they were tiny and while the flavor was there it wasn't anything special. Even tho we ordered the large order of wings we were still hungry and ordered the buffalo chicken with Mac and cheese. That was the best thing I ate all night there. The place is good for beer and watching a game but it lacked on the food department !

One of the best Happy Hour restaurants in Santa Barbara (4:00-8:00PM) daily.
Great selection ranging from steamed mussels to Kobe beef sliders.
My wife and I visit this place at least once a month. Their happy hour is one of the best in Santa Barbara, 
Our favorite items from the Happy Hour menu are, the steamed mussels prepared in garlic sauce, fried calamaris and mesquite grilled artichoke.
From the main menu my favorite is the blackened mahi-mahi. 
The happy hour wine and beer start at $4.00 and margaritas from $5.50. Excellent parking at the train station adjacent to Enterprise (90 minutes free)

Always a fav of my Mother and mine 
We have been coming a long time. 
I had a five star review. 
The food has always delighted us and great atmosphere.  If it's 1:30 I don't recommend this place as it closes a 2:00.  We came at 1:30 and were promptly seated.  Ordered fast with a sweet waitress.  Then mom said she wanted to take a photo of the fountain and someone just came by and unplugged it.  (Not aware what we were doing -but hey.. it's close to closing time right?!)  then someone was using a (huge) lawn blower (we were seated outside) and set it on the empty table beside us like a freaking centerpiece ... it stayed there till the end of our meal.  And precisely at 2:00 the music went off so it appears as if we are seated in a Barron closed facility.  Each guest should experience the same quality experience if they welcome us in our money is just as valuable and so are we!! -we shouldn't feel like an imposing group of campers.  By the time I paid (46.00 for two - not cheap) I had to unlock the door to get out.  Photos taken as we left... looks like they are ready to leave at 2:00 and do so by 2:30.

Pizza  was wonderful. There homemade sausage is  the best along the garlic butter on the crust. Found it near our vacation rental and would  definitely recommend. Love it when we find great local establishments.

Most of the time they are great. But I've tried to call the phone number they present on Google, 30 times in the last hour and a half, with no answer, to only warn them (not ask for a refund) that their halibut cevice, "ceviche de pescado" is so fishy smelling it made me gag, dispute my absolute love of sea food.

This meal was absolutely delicious all around. We started with a bottle of wine brought over from Bar Hygge and a tomato salad. The lunch menu had something for everyone. Unfortunately, there were long wait times to be seated despite having a reservation followed by a long wait for the food. Fortunately, the food was worth the wait and we will be back.

A friend & I were talking tacos & comparing good taco places near us.  He mentioned how much he loves Florida Sub's tacos.  I started laughing...whoever heard of a sub place serving tacos, let alone great tacos?  I am no longer laughing.  Today at lunch my wife & I went there & ordered several varieties of tacos.  In my book they were as authentic & tasty as they come.  The restaurant itself is frozen in time with an inside decor from maybe the 1960's?  But it's all about the food, & the tacos were excellent.  I ordered three.  One was spicy chicken, one was plain chicken, & one was lamb.  I ordered them Tex-Mex style.  They arrived with two corn tortillas double protecting the contents.  The tacos were bursting with cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, meat, & an accompaniment of two sauces, limes, & sour cream.  The taste was spicy & perfect.  For a minute I forgot about the pandemic, & experienced a lunchtime vacation south of the border.

Always great. Table side salsa delish, margaritas on POINT! I have never had anything bad there. Lobster Enchiladas probably
My favorite. Tried the California burrito this time. Did not disappoint!

Having read positive things about Oloroso, our party of four was excited about our dinner. The front and rear rooms are very attractive. The staff was great, professional,fun, and caring. The atmosphere was upbeat. Two of our party decided on numerous tapas for dinner, the other two a couple of tapas and sharing a large paella Oloroso. The tapas diners really enjoyed 4 of their 9 tapas, the remainder so so or no. We the diners who shared the paella also had 2 tapas first. The salt cod potatoes were great(could eat them for a whole meal). The anchovies not so good or special. The paella was truly terrible. It was oily, soaked in a tomato sauce that in no way resembled any paella ever experienced. It has fairly large chunks of meat that were not discernible, no chorizo that I found, a few measly mussels, and a few tiny shrimp. The paella had a strange overall taste with absolutely no crust on the bottom since the oily substance was everywhere. Don't know why I didn't send it back. Big disappointment. Won't return.

Great local breakfast place.  Very casual, really nice people and lots of locals so you know it's good.

Small place but worth sitting next to some you do not know

This was a happy accident because we were trying to find Buoy's which was across the street and closed for repairs. This place looked interesting so we decided to give it a try. We sat upstairs at the bar and Thomas, the bartender, waited on us. Great drink selection, wonderful view and terrific food! We all had drinks and appetizers. My Cobb salad was fresh and delicious, as was the Ahi Tuna salad and the shrimp. The service was good and the prices were fair. It has a great view of the water and you are high enough to see out into the bay and enjoy the ocean breeze.
Was told by a friend to visit and try a Paulatini. Did not disappoint! Friendly staff and a lovely outdoor area. Smells of shrimp and spices filled the air. Made me wish I was hungry!

It was my husband's birthday and he wanted to try something new. We landed on Land and Ocean.  The website was really easy to make a reservation on and even gave times that were available in the time frame I wanted.  We were greated at the door and were seated pretty promptly.  We waited for a bit for our actual server but we were given water and menus. 
We ordered the beef wellington and grilled artichokes for the appetizers and they were really good.  We did notice that the seasoning on the artichoke seemed to only be on one half (luckily my half) but it was still good.  The beef wellington ton was a little under welling but the sauce that it was served on was good.
For dinner we ordered the Lavish burger and the Land Ocean.  I ordered the burger medium rare and it was perfect.  My husband ordered the "Land Ocean" (filet and crab or lobster) and although they were out of crab he wanted lobster anyway and both were well cooked as well.
We ordered the banana cream pie for dessert.  It wasn't overly sweet which I really enjoyed.
They kept our water full and the table cleared off as soon as we were done with a plate.  The only real "complaints" I have are the waitress never told us the specials.  We only knew there were some because we over heard her telling them to the tables around us.  We also never got the table bread which is not a big deal but a little annoying.  It also took a bit for them to take our credit card.  My husband calls it "holding us hostage".   But all in a

Great bar with good food and excellent service. Stopped by during New year's time because we were staying in the area. Bar was packed and bartender was working with a smile and great attitude! A guy got drunk and caused a scene and tried to loud talk the bartender. He shut that down quickly and then poured the rest of us shots for our inconvenience of listening to the drunk! Great staff and excellent customer service! We will definitely be back next time we are in town!

We went through the drive through because it's closed inside. But they messed up our order completely. The line wasn't even that long and they were completely incompetent. We ordered sides and never got them. We ordered biscuits and meals that came with biscuits and never got them. They gave us tenders instead of bone in. They obviously only care about drive through times because they just threw together a bag. My kids were disappointed and not fed all the way. I will not be going back and I will make sure everyone knows this restaurant is not somewhere to go during this time. Taco Bell and McDonald's and all other restaurants are stepping it up and Popeyes is not. Unfortunately it won't let me give 0 stars.

This is the Chick-fil-A by which all others should be judged. In fact, they should just rename it "The Standard." This location is often ridiculously busy, so much that you would think the nutritional needs of all Franklin residents rest upon the shoulders of this chicken shack alone. Regardless, my order is always delivered quickly, correctly and with a truly friendly smile. I will continue to go out of my way to pick up a meal at the Columbia Avenue location. Thank you!

I ordered a pizza and a salad. Open the salad and there were three croutons and one piece of cheese and most of the lettuce was brown. When I showed up with the food to get my money back the manger scolded me like I was his child and asked me what I expected . I expect food that I paid for. He continues to scold me and then when I come back at him he gets offended. When he hands me the money he refused to give me the change and threw it on the counter. I know I look young but I am a 34 year old with two children. Age shouldn't even matter, if I was a man I guess he would of had a different tone. It's a shame because I have eaten here before and had nothing but good things to say.

food was just okay service was above average i had gotten the soup and soup dumplings. I like how the soup dumplings were made in the bamboo basket versus metal. the pork belly wasn't tender. the noodles weren't as thick. broth was bland.

I usually love Arni's, albeit I have not been to this location in a while, however, I ordered delivery of a $28 Pizza and was terribly disappointed.  There was virtually no sauce or cheese on this pizza and it arrived luke warm.  Perhaps it is a sign of COVID but I doubt I visit or order from them again.  South of Chicago Pizza and Greeks are right down the street.

Phenomenal food, service and overall experience. The service is wonderful, friendly and personal. The servers and bar staff are beyond knowledgeable on the food menu and drink selection. They know their wines, liquors and cocktails. They are prepared to do a proper wine service including decanter service. They will do dinner service at your pace so you can move as slow or as quick as their kitchen will allow. We chose to move at a slower pace so we could enjoy our cocktails and wine. We did the secret menu for two which was the ribeye steak, ravioli, scallops, vegetable, salad, bread and dessert of your choice. You can do a different steak selection but we chose the ribeye which was amazing. The char on the outside was perfection. The inside was tender, cooked to my perfection and asking, juicy and marbled throughout. This was the best steak I have had not only locally but anywhere in the country. They age their steaks in house for 35 days which I think is the key to success. You can tell they have mastered their recipes and it shows from their hand made raviolis to their perfectly seared scallops. I can't wait to return and would recommend this establishment to any patron looking for an amazing dinner or to celebrate a special occasion. Thank you Beau and Mo's!

This brewhouse is the best in Edmonton by far Adam and Kelsey were awesome! Always had one of them coming by to see how we were doing. Adam was super polite and great to talk to. Kelsey was attentive and was there whenever we needed a refill!!

Ok service, good food! Would recommend going to as they always have tables open and the food comes out very quick, even on weekends during the dinner rush. I've been here several times in the last month and have been satisfied with their quality of food everytime.

Food is hardly ever fresh, burgers sloppy or dried out. Fries typically either extra soggy with grease or old. Whenever asked for an iced coffee with cream n sugar, it comes out like diabetes! Lol one sip of pure sugar and cream , hardly an hint of coffee in there. They seriously need to get better with their beverages. Sorry, I really don't like to give out negative reviews but this location has been a let down for some time now . I still go lol. Its like hit or miss hahahsha

Best pizza in town! So fresh, so delicious. We've had the Margarita, East Coast Pepperoni & Butcher Shop pizzas. All 5 starts! Our order is always correct (even when I made the mistake in ordering) and ready on time. Super friendly staff!! We'll be back.
Delicious! I ordered master mahi mahi. Fresh with an incredible sauce. A hint of heat but nothing over powering. Also got the crab fries, one word ....incredible! Flavor blast from the aioli mmmm

First of all, have a sweater or jacket if you plan on eating there...its freezing inside.  After we placed our order, we asked for a glass of water to drink.  They could not, would not give us water!  We don't drink soda. Out the door we went!  Note -  the place was empty!

Curry chicken noodle bowl is so soul satisfying. We get extra noodles and share. Tuesday lunch panang beef curry with fresh lime leaves is so yummy. I wish they had white rice but oh well. Draughtsmen beer too!!

We have gone here numerous times. I sometimes wait months between visits hoping it will be better. Ordering from Door Dash is always good, though. But the service and cleanliness of the restaurant is awful. Something about the place is just gross. So greasy in the air. Tables and floor always dirty. Some servers appear unbathed. I just went to redeem my birthday reward, but they said no because they didn't see my birthday on my rewards number. I pulled up my account on my phone and showed my license, and the waitress spoke to me like I am just trying to get a handout. I was appalled as I have spent plenty of money there, never received anything for free. They should not offer a birthday reward and then not honor it. I have given them my personal info and spent money with them but was treated badly when time to redeem the offer. So, we are enjoying a nice meal at Charlestons, where the food and service is consistent. I don't think we will ever be back to this location. It's horribly managed and never puts the customer first.

Cafe Porche, two words. BEYOND AMAZING ! A Hidden Gem. We were greeted by the wonderful Coronella and kitchen staff! We were seated immediately and ordered our drinks/food. The three of us ordered Smothered Shrimp & Grits, "Lakeview Morning" (Catfish), and "Good Morning Sweetness" (French Toast). Our food came out in no time! Hot, Tasty, Scrumptious, and Oh So Delicious. You can tell the food was made with love. This will me a must-go to, everytime we are in New Orleans. Thank you so much for your service !
Food is not good greasy,tasteless,.it seems to get worst as time goes by.only go to celebrate a friends birthday
The food here has always been fresh and delicious. The staff are always welcoming and customer service is great. Can't beat the prices! My favorite little hole in the wall.

I absolutely love this place! It reminds of coffee shops that serve food back on the east coast, very cute and laid back with incredible food. The carnitas were so well seasoned and perfectly cooked, and our drinks were spot on with the flavor. We will be returning soon for the ambiance and food (and I'll be back for more chai lattes!)

First time trying the Backyard and it was very good! They take social distancing seriously and have only a few tables on the inside all a good distance apart. I got the wings and my fiancé the brisket sandwich. Both delicious! The ranch was AMAZING. There is no serve yourself drinks so you get bottles soda. My fiancé had to wait a while for refills but the staff was very friendly just not attentive as maybe they could be.

I decided to try this place in passing. I'm so glad I did! The food and the service was excellent. I usually go to a Korean restaurant in Philadelphia but after eating here, I don't feel the need to travel far to get quality Korean food. To start with, I got the Korean fried chicken. The sauce was delicious and the wings were extra crispy! For my meal I got a Bulgogi Dolsot. The prime rib was delicious and tender. I can't wait until I come here again!

I love pizza. Fox's Pizza Den did not disappoint! I was craving New York style pizza, and after searching Google and Yelp, I gave them a try, and I'm glad I did!

I ordered a Marguarita Pizza and breaded mushrooms. The pizza...OMG. 

Crust - delicious. Chewy, AND crisp, not too thick, and really, really good. 

Cheese - the right level of saltiness, perfect quantity, melted to perfection, and lightly browned.

Toppings - fresh tomatoes, lots of fresh basil, just perfect.

Last but not least, the sauce. Mmm. It's like a fresh, plump, sun-kissed tomato is dancing with a backup squad of gentle herb and olive oil dancers, performing a show of light and sweet choreography for my riveted taste buds. 

Added bonus, everything came HOT, and 30 mins faster than the confirmed time. Huge smile on the delivery guys face was a big plus. 

Can you please open a franchise in Milwaukee?
Excellent . So far we've had DeNiro, the Sam Elliot, the Turkey and the pickle Rick. The sandwiches are huge but top quality. You can choose from traditional hoagies and cheesesteaks as well

Love this place!  Very laid back and fun inside decorations.  Chip bar is great!  The food is good and plenty.  I live in VA and visit every time I'm in town.  One of the only places where you can get a pitcher of margaritas!  No need to upgrade them.  The house margarita is great and has plenty of kick, not just all mix.  If you are looking for a fun, relaxed atmosphere and love chips and salsa this is your place.
The best smoked fish I've ever had. I tried this place while in St Pete for the weekend on a friends recommendation. And I so glad that I did.
Really delicious and filling. Very casual atmosphere. It's pricey for a lunch, but you certainly won't be hungry afterwards. An essential American take on vaguely Italian cuisine. Highly recommended.

Mike's is perfectly placed for ice cream after you have a few drinks on Broadway. 

Located around the corner of the main Broadway street.

Long big shop. Plenty of seating inside. Big ice cream menu.

No line when I came but when we were ready to leave, the line was 10 people deep. 

Staff were friendly. I got to try a few samples. 

Double Scoop - $4.95 - Pistachio & Pralines & Cream - Flavors were good. Very creamy. Melts fast when outside. Eat it fast!

Even with the pandemic, this place remains friendly and so quick with the food too.  Of course they follow all the current health and safety regualtions.

I took full advantage of the Yelp check in offer of free curry fries, which btw were absolutely delicious and such a huge amount of fries that I shared with the entire table. 

I also enjoyed the fried shrimp appetizer. Delicious, nice, crisp, hot and worth it. I probably could have asked for a little more of the aioli though. 

For my entree I chose the fish and chips, full portion ... on hindsight I could have done with half a portion. Oh well, live and learn, right? The fish was perfect. Light and crispy on the outside without being greasy and tender flaky on the inside. Perfect.

I was talked into sharing an elephant ear, yeah it took a lot of convincing there... NOT... I love those and since there wasn't a state fair this year... anyway, the elephant ears alone are reason to pay this place a visit... huge and covered in cinnamon suger just like they are supposed to be... yumm
Went there today. There were 2 donut options. I ordered Cookies and Cream and got cinnamon sugar.

The chocolate syrup drizzled over our plate of crepe and coconut icecream? So sweet!! Our waitress? Just as sweet and attentive and very kind. 

Decided to visit with a friend because another friend highly recommended this place!

The interiors are brightly lit and beautiful! Incorporated a lot of pretty elements, was spacious with a smaller upstairs dine-in area. Absolutely gorgeous.

Food was beyond expectations! Super delicious--definitely try coconut ice cream!!!! Flavor and texture and sweetness was heavenly! 

We got the CYO meal, with a choice of a crepe or waffle, ice cream flavor, and a list of fruits and combinations. Ranges around $9-10. 

I love everything, and they're also reasonably price! You're not forced to hand over a pretty penny for some trendy, beautifully handcrafted desert meal.

Affordable tacos, good for the price. Ordered the al pastor and the steak. Meat was tough, but flavors good. Only downside was waiting to order. There wasn't a person stationed at the register, so we had to wait until the cook went to check the window.

Once in a great while you find something that makes you believe in magic and the greatness of humanity again ... best way I can describe my very first visit to REPEAL restaurant in Fountain Square. 

And get the Chicken  and Biscuits with the apple butter maple syrup

I've come here 100+ times, starting in 2012.
Overall, the food has had its ups and downs, but always been between 4-5 stars.

I have two issues that people need to be aware of... things that could really upset customers. And, unfortunately we know friends that will not go back. Frankly, we are at about our end too.

1) They ask you if you would like a spice level 1-5, 5 being Thai Spice. However, sometimes a 4 will be a 1, and a 2 will be so hot the person who ordered it can't eat it.

Today, I asked for a 3 so my wife could eat some of mine. It was prepared hotter than they have ever made it. I enjoyed it, but my wife was upset.

2) For take out, they add a 15% service fee to receipts over $20. While that is a new stated policy, they have also added it to under $20 takeout, and it's a policy that no other place near us uses.

I will not pay 15% service fee, 9.25% tax, and 20% tip. I think that is way beyond prudent expectations.

So, while we do still eat here. We have become vary wary and reduced our patronage to once every few months (as opposed to once a week)

I do hope they turn their business around. (And I will adjust my review accordingly)

Pizza was good but the service was awful.  I live down the street and they wanted to charge like $4 for delivery.  So I went and picked it up.  They didn't have change.  Offered quarters instead of singles or to pay by card.  I opted the card route.  They didn't tell me there was a CC convenience charge until after I ran my card.  When I got home the pizza was good.  However, my taco pie the lettuce was old, barely shred, and there was about 2 oz of ground beef on the entire thing.  I will not be going back.
First time eating here.   Food was served hot and very good.  My husband & I shared an entree...more than enough.   We tried their Mongolian beef.

Honestly, a very poor pizza. Dry. Not much flavor. This must be what eating cardboard is like. The advertised picture online promised a pizza well-covered with toppings and cheese, but the reality was a pizza, a product that skimps on just about everything. We ordered a regular hand-tossed pizza and it was so thin that I truly wonder what is thin crust is from this establishment. I had the same problem from this Pizza Hut years ago and called in advance to ask them if they still skimp on toppings. They assured me that the pizza would look like what I saw advertised which was a three-topping large pizza. They lied and they created a crappy pizza. There were slices that had only one small piece of pineapple on them. Buyer beware. They had their chance to win me back as a customer, and they blew it. I will never come back to this Pizza Hut. I can only hope that Pizza Hut far and wide does not practice putting out a poor product like this place does. This manager should be fired for letting this store sell inferior pizzas to their customers. On a good note, the customer service was pleasant. They offered to add pineapple to the pizza. I should have looked closer and realized that this pizza was utterly dry and then decided to take my business elsewhere. Burn me once shame on you burn me now I third time, yes I'm an idiot for giving them a chance. Never again!
My friend and I shared a burnt ends sandwich ($11.99) and a BBQ chicken sandwich ($9.99). They were OK but nothing special. There is better barbecue elsewhere in town.

This was a hustling place at 7:45 a.m. on a Saturday.  We were seated quickly and the server took our order.  There was not a long wait for the food or even the check for that matter.  They have a large dining space with booths on the outside perimeter and tables for four in the middle.  Servers were attentive.  Never ran out of coffee.  Food was very good, but a little bland.  I want to come back again to try their lunch items.
Order the clam chowder! The view is also amazing and so peaceful. Waitress and servers were very nice, the place was clean and following all covid guidelines.

I had the deluxe vermicelli to go while my friend got the pho and shrimp summer rolls. The ingredients were very fresh and they tasted great (the shrimp summer rolls weren't the best I've had, but the sauce is on point). The portion was decent for the price too. Would definitely visit again.

Probably some of the best coffee in the city, scrumptious macarons, great study spot, community place with kids and dogs everywhere, love it!! Sad the Magazine location closed - that one was so gorgeous and classy. This one is much airier and open though

Absolutely love Brown's!  My wife and I have frequented since it's opening.  We've had a bit of everything and it's all been amazing.  Doesn't hurt that the customer service is great as well.  So nice to have this quaint pastry shop in the area.
This place Is a hidden gem. So delicious. I had the Mexican omelette and I would definitely go back and order it again.

Great oysters happy hour specials. Chowder was loaded with clams and great flavor and texture. Scallops were huge and cooked perfectly. Came here 3 times the week I was in town. Sat a bar each time and all the bartenders did a great job. Only downer is they charge you for bread. Other than that great seafood place to hit downtown.

Mano's is becoming my "go to"spot whether for a nosh and wine, dinner or a quick take out. They are friendly, efficient and the chef is wonderful!  Never disappointed....the fish specials are perfect. It's not just another Italian restaurant   The menu has offerings to satisfy all in your party

This was one of our first stops in the morning before we did a full day of foodie stops. We ordered 3 different types of eggs Benedict's but I ordered the Peacemaker - which allowed me to pick two! The two I decided on was the Smoked Salmon and the Eggs Cochon. Not bad. The egg was still runny - which is a good thing. The biscuit was average. The toppings weren't amazing to warrant a crazy rating. They were just okay.

First off i waited 10 minutes in the drive thru with only one person in front of me. Whatever i get it's dinner time. I get up to order, i have to wait again, i start to order and they are out of bread, how are you Panera BREAD and out of bread??? I don't understand. Whatever. I get to the window, the workers were RUDE as HELL! They hand me my food and then my drink and just close the window.. no have a great night, no thank you, no nothing, just closed the window. 
I ordered a pick 2 and got mac n cheese and a CHICKEN caesar salad and a bowl of chicken noodle. I got home and there is no chicken in my salad.. so i paid for the chicken caesar, but just got a caesar. I come here all the time, being i work just down the street, and this isn't the first time i've been less than impressed. 
I will start making the extra 5 minute drive and going to the St. Charles one!

Went in because of the name, I will be back because of the food.

I'm from El Paso, Texas and am a bit spoiled by our Mexican food.  I rarely eat Mexican food outside of El Paso County.  However, this food was fresh and delicious.  The tacos were fabulous as was the carne asada torta.  Can't wait to come back.

I wish I had asked for our server's name.  He was very helpful and took really good care of us.  Great experience!

Bad ass food, y'all!

Lariele, Lariele what ever happened to your good taste? Sadly, all good things must come to an end, and Lariele has reached that end. 

I'm willing to pay a lot for a good pizza but $27.50 for an underdone poorly cooked soggy flop pie.  Nope. Go to Santucci's or Pica's.

Very Covid compliant!!! Not crowded at all. They have just a few seats inside and two tables outside. I am so happy to find a restaurant like that. And food was delicious too. Usually restaurants don't pay much attention to sides, not this place! Their sides ( grain pilaf and roasted veggies) are both super tasty. Their slaw was great too, just the right vinegar and seasoning, nothing heavy.  Ahi Tuna is comparatively not as impressive but still good - could use more seasoning imo. I asked for more done than rare and the chef cooked it to the perfect medium rare.
Great if you plan on having a beer or two then head shopping! Didn't eat but the restaurant scored a 99% on their sanitation. Seems like a good spot.

Went here for my first post-Covid lockdown restaurant experience. I was hesitant about it but after reading their website that listed all of the protocols I felt like they had a handle on the situation more than other places that are open. They made us feel as safe as possible with the way things are right now. We waited outside for a table after placing our name on the list through Yelp. We were sat 10 feet away from the next table. The employees all wore masks and the people that brought the food wore gloves. They put paper over the table that was discarded for the next guests. We saw them wipe chairs down between seatings. They did an incredible job as a whole. Heather gave us outstanding service and after having crab cakes, calamari, grouper, and key lime ice cream that were all delicious I can't wait to go back

The service was great and a wonderful selection of beers. I love IPAs. The wings were big and fatty even with the request of 'well done- extra crispy' still fatty skin and i prefer the smaller wings. I would return for sports watching, people watching and beer. Huge selection of food so I would try another snack. Service really took them above and it's a random house in the middle of the block. Adorable.
